name: Vstav'te vtoroj disk
source:
It's the mid-2000s. Computers and the internet are becoming an integral part of our lives, but not everyone is up to speed with these new, sophisticated devices. Lisa is one of those people. To play the new game all her friends are talking about, she has to overcome her compulsion and invite a classmate to help, sincerely hoping she won't regret it.

[Translated from [url=https://tezuka-alex.itch.io/2ndcd]itch.io[/url]]
